```python
def shell_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2

    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, n):
            temp = arr[i]
            j = i - gap

            while j >= 0 and arr[j] > temp:
                arr[j + gap] = arr[j]
                j -= gap
            arr[j + gap] = temp

        gap //= 2
```
